picks.catalyst: In-session: the Anthropic IPO is being priced by the market this morning and Amazon is the largest outside holder. 06:38 the amended S-1 set 801M shares at $70-78; 09:55 the Financial Times reported Goldman Sachs expects Anthropic revenue to exceed $600B by 2030 (Amazon already booked a $50.5B upward adjustment on its Anthropic preferred in Q2, so the IPO marks that stake again); Amazon also announced its Black Friday Week events (06:32). The tape agrees: AMZN 266.33 open -> 271.70 at 10:17 (+2.0% from the open, +1.8% on the day, high 272.88 minutes ago) while SPY is +0.3% from its open and the 'Anthropic beneficiaries' (AMD +5.9% from open on its $2.5B IPO investment, TSM +2.3% on its Anthropic/OpenAI investments, MU +1.9%) lead; internet theme neutral with REL_STRONG + BREADTH_UP. Within the 3% line, reported 10-29 (no window). Risks: platforms were sold intraday Monday (AMZN -0.9% open to close), the hot CPI has yields up (TLT -1.3%) which taxes long duration, and the 11-02 AMZN lesson (picked at +4% from open, topped minutes later). Shadow-only sample since 2026-11-09 (catalyst_intraday real_risk 0; the hero shadow takes the full ledger).
picks.catalyst_zh: 今天市场在给 Anthropic 的 IPO 定价，亚马逊是它最大的外部股东：招股书 06:38 定了 8 亿股、70–78 美元的区间，09:55 金融时报说高盛预计 Anthropic 2030 年收入超过 6,000 亿美元（亚马逊二季度已把这笔持股账面上调 505 亿，IPO 等于再标一次价），早上还公布了黑五周活动。走势配合：开盘 266.33 到 10:17 的 271.70（比开盘 +2.0%，刚创日高 272.88），而标普只比开盘 +0.3%，Anthropic 受益股（AMD +5.9%、台积电 +2.3%、美光 +1.9%）在领涨。风险：昨天平台股盘中被卖、CPI 偏热利率在升。从昨晚起盘中 pick 只记影子。

check_1016: 10:17 ET: pick AMZN call 0.40 (above). Sniper: TSM gapped down to 388.22 and held its open, so catalyst_open booked the 11-13 417.5C at 0.82 (shadow, 1 contract) at 09:32 and the hero 415C x4 at 1.01; at 10:1x they are 2.25 (+174%) and 2.80 (+177%). Other: AAPL 347.3 (-1.0%, -1.1% from open; the only platform red), MSFT -0.6%, META +1.2% from open, TSLA +1.75% from open, LLY +1.2% from open (1419.8, above the hero 1470C's path? still -35% on the contract), WMT -0.4% from open (the carried 131C is 0.09 at the mid), GS +0.9%, JPM +0.3%; GEV 789 (-4.8% day but +4.6% from a 754.56 open: the pre-market dump was real and bought), CAT 585 (-2.3%, +2.5% from open), VST +1.6% from open, COIN -2.2% (-0.6% from open). Not picked: AMD (own catalyst but +5.9% from its open, beyond the 3% line), AVGO/MRVL/LITE (sympathy in a turning theme), TSM (already the sniper's name), MU (+1.9% from open, 'participates' is a minor item, turning theme), NVDA put (relative weakness with yesterday's news; the mirror needs SMH below its open and SMH is +2.2% above it), GEV call (bounce without news). Gainers lists DAY_1 / MIN_5 are micro caps (PEPG, SMX, OMH, AAON +26% on earnings); losers micro caps (APPS -36%, EQPT -22%).
conditional_1121: Put mirror: not armed and far from it (SMH +2.2% from its open, every chip above its open except NVDA -0.7%); it would need SMH back under 479.00 with NVDA (the weakest, already below its open) as the name. Call side at 11:21: the Anthropic-beneficiary theme (AMD, TSM, MU, AMZN) is the day's story; a second pick is not allowed (catalyst_intraday one entry a day), so 11:21 judges AMZN (wrong if below 266.33, its open) and logs the rest. If SPY loses 748.29 (its open) with TLT still falling, the hot-CPI tape returns and the morning bounce was the whole day.
